head: codex/143-v092-adr-authoring
title: [v0.92][ADR] Author the milestone architecture decision record set
body:
Closes #143

## Outcome

Authors the complete v0.92 ADR 0059-0071 candidate packet without accepting any ADR. The reviewed disposition denominator is **8 Proposed / 5 Deferred**.

## Evidence corrections

- ADR 0059 is limited to deterministic structural candidate validation; trusted witness and freshness authority remain separate in ADR 0062.
- ADR 0061 binds Memory Palace and capability-envelope claims to exact typed #5828 and #5829 validation receipts.
- ADRs 0062, 0063, and 0064 are Proposed from ancestral WP-15, #144 authority repair, and WP-13A proof.
- ADR 0065 is Deferred because #5832 retains an empty native receipt and no machine-readable SOR validation outcomes.
- ADR 0066 is Deferred behind open #142 production Guardian/kernel and live-polis proof.
- ADRs 0068, 0069, and 0071 remain Deferred behind their named executable proof gaps.

## Validation and review

- Focused ADR packet validator: PASS.
- Every Proposed executable validation path is bound to a declared typed SOR and an exact passing evidence reference.
- Every evidence artifact is bound to its last-touch revision, ancestral to the retained baseline.
- Diff hygiene: PASS.
- Fresh independent exact-head substantive review at `aa22f78c3bfc0ece577fedf6aa7e6bb43fcca94d`: PASS with no P0-P3 findings.
- The subsequent `df8f4aa9a` commit contains typed review metadata only.

## Boundaries

- No ADR is Accepted by this PR.
- No file under `docs/adr/` is created or changed.
- Deferred candidates remain explicitly blocked and make no operational completion claim.
